plugins.name: Spotify
plugins.description: Resolves artists to Spotify IDs with the Client Credentials flow: exchanges client id/secret for a token, then searches by artist name or ISRC (`/v1/search`) and persists only the ID. Requires the client ID and client secret of a Spotify app from the developer dashboard. Use "Test connection" to verify the credentials can obtain a token.
plugins.author: TMA

http.reason: Spotify Client Credentials 换取 access token

plugins.name: Apple Music
plugins.description: Resolves artists to Apple Music catalog IDs by searching the catalog (`/v1/catalog/{storefront}/search`), so artists can link back to Apple Music. Requires a developer token (a MusicKit ES256 JWT); the storefront defaults to `us`. Use "Test connection" to verify the token and storefront before scraping.
